blurb: Liquid Alaska Tours offers high-end Alaskan experiences showcasing the unique landscape and culture around Mendenhall Glacier. Guests can explore the glacier and surrounding wilderness by canoe and hiking. The tours provide intimate views and educational commentary about the glacier and local phenomena.
